gloss: to play the fool, to make a joke (comedy)

definitions.gloss: to play the fool, to deliver the funny line
definitions.explanation: In Japanese comedy (especially manzai), to take the role of the funny one who says silly or absurd things, prompting the straight man (tsukkomi) to react.

examples.japanese: ここでボケるのはやめて。
{彼|かれ}がボケて、{相方|あいかた}がツッコむ。
examples.english: He plays the fool, and his partner delivers the retort.

examples.japanese: せっかくボケたのに、だれもツッコんでくれなかった。
examples.english: I set up a joke, but nobody played along with a comeback.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive).

This is the comedy-specific sense of ボケる, derived from the manzai comedy tradition.

COMEDY CONTEXT:
In {漫才|まんざい} (manzai), the ボケ (boke) is the funny one who says absurd things, while the ツッコミ (tsukkomi) is the straight man who corrects or reacts. ボケる means to take on that comedic role.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ボケとツッコミ: the funny man and the straight man
- うまくボケる: to deliver a good joke
- ボケが{滑|すべ}る: a joke that falls flat

NOTE:
Usually written in katakana as ボケる in the comedy sense. A separate word ぼける (hiragana) means "to become senile" or "to become blurry."
